name: Takamura Chiwako
source:
A tall girl who is simple and unsophisticated.
She cares about her friend Nanaka and is supportive of her love.

Tall and plain girl.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1161863]Getchu[/url]]
